name: OKC_CONTACTS_H
description: Contract contacts are child entities to Contract parties. Just like parties a contact has a defined role in a contract like Contract Manager, Buyer etc. The contact is the point of contact for the party in the context of the created contract.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Primary key for Contract Party Contact.

columns.name: CONTACT_PUID
columns.description: Contact PUID

columns.name: MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: Major Version Number

columns.name: VERSION_TYPE
columns.description: VERSION_TYPE can have 3 values: C, A & H. Updates are allowed only if the Version_Type is 'C'

columns.name: CPL_ID
columns.description: Party Role associated with this contact. Refers to ID in OKC_K_PARTY_ROLES_B.

columns.name: CRO_CODE
columns.description: Role code of the contact. Refers to Contact Roles setup.

columns.name: DNZ_CHR_ID
columns.description: Id of the contract for which the contact is defined, always populated for performance reasons.

columns.name: OBJECT1_ID1
columns.description: Identifier1 of the contact in the source system.

columns.name: OBJECT1_ID2
columns.description: Identifier2 of the contact in the source system.

columns.name: JTOT_OBJECT1_CODE
columns.description:
Identifies the source of the contact, setup via Contact Role Sources which point to JTF Objects (arbitrary view definitions).
For e.g.,
Salesperson (OKX_SALEPERS) ??? Salesreps from Resource Manager
Party Contact (OKX_PCONTACT) ??? Party Contacts from TCA
Customer contact for Billing (OKX_CONTBILL) ??? Customer Contacts from TCA
Vendor Contact (OKX_VCONTACT) ??? PO Vendor Contacts from PO

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the contact.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the contact.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CONTACT_SEQUENCE
columns.description: The order in which to contact.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
